code: ## Cut and scale the trees cascade_defect <- merchandise(tree_id = trees$tree_id,                               dbh = trees$dbh,                               ht = trees$ht,                               spcd = trees$spcd,                               products = specifications,                               age = trees$age,                               defects = example_defects_pnw,                               strategy = 'cascade') ## Cut and scale the trees optimized_defect <- merchandise(tree_id = trees$tree_id,                                 dbh = trees$dbh,                                 ht = trees$ht,                                 spcd = trees$spcd,                                 products = specifications,                                 age = trees$age,                                 defects = example_defects_pnw,                                 strategy = 'optimize') ## Sum cascade log values by tree cascade_values_defect <- cascade_defect$logs %>%   group_by(tree_id) %>%   summarize(cascade_dollars = sum(value))  ## Sum optimized log values by tree optimized_values_defect <- optimized_defect$logs %>%   group_by(tree_id) %>%   summarize(optimized_dollars = sum(value))  ## Calculate each tree's value gain gain_defect <- trees %>%   select(tree_id = tree_id) %>%   left_join(y = cascade_values_defect,             by = 'tree_id') %>%   left_join(y = optimized_values_defect,             by = 'tree_id') %>%   mutate(cascade_dollars = coalesce(cascade_dollars, 0),          optimized_dollars = coalesce(optimized_dollars, 0),          gain_dollars = optimized_dollars - cascade_dollars) ## Sum values and gains across the list total_defect <- gain_defect %>%   summarize(cascade_dollars = sum(cascade_dollars),             optimized_dollars = sum(optimized_dollars),             gain_dollars = sum(gain_dollars))
